author: MatheuspCoelho
body:
#### PR description:

Removes DeepCSV components from the HLT b-tag validation for Phase-2. This PR is a new iteration on top of what was implemented in [PR#51831](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51831).

Changes 2 files:

- HLTrigger/Configuration/python/HLTrigger_EventContent_cff.py: drops DeepCSV-related jet tags from the event content (that were previously added in [PR#51831](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51831) for monitoring these paths ).
- HLTriggerOffline/Btag/python/HltBtagValidation_cff.py: removes the corresponding paths and their jettags/filters from the configuration file.


#### PR validation:

`CMSSW_20_1_0_pre5`  `el9_amd64_gcc14`

Phase-2: workflows 37634.0 (Run4D127) and 38434.0 (Run4D128) run end to end. Now the folder with btv plots produces no DeepCSV-related monitoring in HLT/BTV/Validation.

runTheMatrix.py -l limited -i all --ibeos also shows workflows other phase-2 workflows (38434.911, 38496.0, 38500.0, 38634.0, 38434.75) also passing the tests.


Not a backport.
title: Remove DeepCSV from the Phase-2 HLT b-tag monitoring
